content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the PHED Mizoram Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 09-10-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of PHED Mizoram to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the PHED Mizoram Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form for the PHED Mizoram Recruitment 2026 is 09-10-2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Technician (SCADA) (PE) posts?
faq.answer: There are 2 vacancies available for the Technician (SCADA) (PE) post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the minimum and maximum age limit for the posts?
faq.answer: The minimum age limit is 18 years and the maximum age limit is 35 years for all posts.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for General/OBC candidates?
faq.answer: The application fee for General/OBC candidates is Rs. 200.

faq.question: Q5. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process will be based on a Written Test.

faq.question: Q6. What are the educational qualifications required for the Technician (SCADA) (PE) post?
faq.answer: Candidates need to have HSSLC, ITI Certificate in Electrician/Electronic Mechanic/COPA/ICTSM, Mizo Language Proficiency, and basic computer knowledge.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary offered for the Electric Lineman (PE) post?
faq.answer: The salary offered for the Electric Lineman (PE) post is Level-4 Rs. 16,920/- Per Month.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any age relaxation provided?
faq.answer: Yes, age relaxation is provided as per DP&AR(GSW) OM No.A-12011/1/2019-P&AR(GSW) Dt. 3.6.2019.

faq.question: Q9. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The mode of application for this recruitment is Online.
